mapper.select: SELECT job_id, memory_id, action, retry_count FROM agent_memory_embedding_job WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND not_before <= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_memory_embedding_job SET status = 'RUNNING', updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE agent_memory_embedding_job SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE job_id = #{jobId}
UPDATE agent_memory_embedding_job SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = #{retryCount}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE job_id = #{jobId}

UPDATE agent_memory_embedding_job SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = #{retryCount}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, not_before = #{notBefore}, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE job_id = #{jobId}
mapper.insert: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO agent_memory_embedding_job(job_id, memory_id, action) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{memoryId}, #{action})
